## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] A changelog fragment in `changelog.d/<branch-with-dashes>.md` (see `changelog.d/README.md`), not an edit to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No new oxlint hits (`node scripts/check-lint-ratchet.mjs`)
